description: We are building an intuitive navigation and tactical survival guide for Mars exploration under the NASA Space Apps Challenge. By integrating real planetary datasets like high-resolution imagery, topography, and surface hazards, our tool helps future astronauts plan safe, efficient "Marswalks." Join us if you are passionate about multi-planetary human survival, interactive data visualization, and transforming complex space data into high-impact, real-world tools that push the boundaries.
summary:
Challenge-Interplanetary Survival Guide: Martian Map
Imagine if you could plan an out-and-back to mars??!
We Martian Odyssey, have considered the possibility of humans being interplanetary.
We are the Google Maps + Airbnb of mars.
AI used- Gemini (brainstorming), ChatGPT (DATA, analysis), Claude-code (Troubleshooting)
Tech stack- JavaScript, Python, HTML, CSS, three.js, WebGL, JSON
Features-
1)3D rendered map
2)Thermal sensing and image
3)Mineral Data
4)Point to point navigation with obstacle avoidance, radiation avoidance, slope and oxygen level monitoring
5)HUD, with multiple display size integration(can be used in mobile,tablet,laptop etc)
It addresses the challenge by depicting clear and habitable conditions, far from home. While navigating through different terrain in mars, suggesting places to dig and discover
details:
1. How to navigate the website

The main web page shows "Martian Odyssey", our project as well as team name.

Scroll down to see our core objectives and what we represent.

In the "Our Missions" section you will have 2 options to "Explore Jezero Crater" and "Explore Valles Marineris(Candor Chasma)" if you click on any of the buttons you will be redirected to the 3D spatial model of Mars including a Google Earth style animation where you can interact and explore and survive the martian conditions

2. Tech stack and utilization

Rendering Engine: Three.js / WebGL handles the 3D globe geometry, real-time lighting shaders, atmosphere rim-lighting, and camera controllers.

UI Layer: Built with React component architecture to manage interactive overlays, habitat modules, survival telemetry readouts, and the Phobosia luxury booking selector.

Interactivity: Custom recasting handles mouse/cursor tracking over the 3D mesh, enabling dynamic coordinate readouts, seamless panning, and smooth target-locking animations when selecting colonization or estate zones

ASSETS

3.AI used- Gemini (brainstorming), ChatGPT (DATA, analysis), Claude-code (Troubleshooting)

Tech stack- JavaScript, Python, HTML, CSS, three.js, WebGL, JSON

4.Our basic idea was to develop a complete virtual mapping on mars, while considering many criteria, our initial designing was done in FIGMA

5. We wanted our application to be a destination that gives you all the information about, your vitals (oxygen level, suit power...) while also covering navigation

6.Future Foresight

We intend it be a scalable and a viable business model, for tourism in mars

Where tourist who visit have an easy time navigating MARS
